Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations'), we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company in their Meeting held today, i.e. Friday, November 13, 2026 inter alia, considered and approved the following agendas:
1. Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company for the Quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
In terms of the provisions of Regulation 33 of the Listing Regulations, we are enclosing herewith copy of the following: -
a. Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026;
b. Statement of Assets and Liabilities of the Company as at September 30, 2026;
c. Cash Flow Statement for the half year ended as on September 30, 2026; and
d. Limited Review Report received from the Statutory Auditors of the Company on the aforesaid Un-Audited Financial Results.
